title: SCE Experiment 1.4 - Preventive Probe: EC2 Instance Enumeration Prevention
description: This Security Chaos Engineering experiment validates that IAM least privilege policies effectively prevent unauthorized EC2 instance enumeration. The experiment creates a restricted IAM role without ec2:DescribeInstances permission and verifies that attempts to enumerate EC2 instances are blocked with AccessDenied. This validates the preventive control for Attack Step 1.3 (T1580 - Cloud Infrastructure Discovery) in the IMDS Protection Weakening attack chain targeting the banking platform.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: IAM Least Privilege Policy Blocks EC2 Enumeration
